description_en: Queries a list of templates that meet the specified conditions. You can query templates based on information such as the template status and creation source
description_zh: 列出符合条件的模板，支持根据模板状态、创建来源等信息查询
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-templates --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --type Timeline --status Available --create-source OpenAPI --keyword 000020b48fb04483915d4f2cd8ac0000 --sort-type CreationTime:Desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTemplates

parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为20，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The template type.

Valid values:

Timeline

VETemplate
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The template state.

Valid values:

UploadFailed: Failed to upload the video.

ProcessFailed: Failed to process the advanced template.

Available: The template is available.

Uploading: The video is being uploaded.

Created: The template is created but not ready for use.

Processing: The advanced template is being processed
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The source from which the template was created.

Valid values:

AliyunConsole

WebSDK

OpenAPI
parameters.name: create_source

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. You can use the template ID or title as the keyword to search for templates
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，可以根据模板ID和title搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The sorting parameter. By default, the query results are sorted by creation time in descending order.

Valid values:

CreationTime:Asc: sorted by creation time in ascending order.

CreationTime:Desc: sorted by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序参数，默认根据创建时间倒序
